title: Swedish Pancake Dinner
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Swedish-inspired dinner, featuring Swedish pancakes with a German twist.

ingredients.name: pancake mix-ins (choice of: sugar, cinnamon, or swede syrup)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, milk, eggs, and nimble sugar.
Add german butter and swede salt; mix until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on surface.
Flip and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve hot with pancake mix-ins of choice.
Optional: add swede syrup for an extra touch of sweetness.
